acceptable_hypotheses: The timeout alone does not explain the checkpoint advancing without confirmation.
contributing_factors: Aggregate lag dashboard omitted per-partition acknowledgements.
A transient database timeout was a contributing retry signal, not the offset-ordering defect.
corrective_actions: Replay from a verified sink position and add partition acknowledgement metrics.
expected_findings: Committed offset advanced before destination confirmation.
Low aggregate consumer lag did not prove synchronization completed.

expected_timeline.event: Offset advances with fewer sink confirmations
Transient sink timeout lacks replay audit

resolution_details: Checkpoint advancement was paused for reconciliation and bounded replay from the last verified sink position.
root_cause: The consumer advanced committed offsets before confirming destination writes, leaving source events unsynchronized.
